mapper.select: select ROUND(SUM(nsa.score) / NULLIF(SUM(nep.score), 0), 4) as modeScoreRate,nsa.student_id as studentId,nsa.mode_id as modeId,nom.course_id as courseId from nmt_student_achievement nsa left join nmt_evaluate_plan nep on nsa.plan_id = nep.id left join nmt_objective_mode nom on nep.mode_id = nom.mode_id left join nmt_class_student ncs on nsa.student_id = ncs.id where ncs.class_id = #{classId} and nom.course_id = #{courseId} and nsa.deleted = 0 group by nsa.student_id ,nsa.mode_id

select ncs.name as studentName,nsa.student_id as studentId,SUM(nsa.score) as achscore,MAX(nom.score) as omscore ,nsa.mode_id as modeId, nsa.objective_id as objectiveId,nem.name as modeName,nco.name as objectiveName,nco.content, nem.weight,nco.expect_value as expectValue from nmt_student_achievement nsa left join nmt_class_student ncs on nsa.student_id = ncs.id left join nmt_objective_mode nom on nsa.objective_id = nom.objective_id and nsa.mode_id = nom.mode_id left join nmt_course_objective nco on nom.objective_id = nco.id left join nmt_evaluate_mode nem on nom.mode_id = nem.id WHERE ncs.class_id = #{classId} and nom.course_id = #{courseId} and nsa.deleted = 0 GROUP BY nsa.student_id,nsa.mode_id ,nsa.objective_id ORDER BY nsa.objective_id,nsa.mode_id,ncs.number
